ext.description: Cursor-style coding agent for VS Code powered by Hermes Agent over ACP, with your own model endpoint.
ext.untrusted: The Hermes agent is disabled until the workspace is trusted.
cfg.path: Path to the `hermes` executable. Leave empty to search `PATH` and the default install location.
cfg.language: Language of the Hermes panel. `auto` follows the VS Code display language.
cmd.removeApprovalHook: Remove Terminal Approval Hook from Hermes Config
cfg.activeProfile: Active endpoint profile: `hermes` (your own Hermes config) or the id of a profile in `hermes.profiles`.
cfg.profiles: Custom endpoint profiles. API keys are stored separately in VS Code SecretStorage, never here.
cfg.mcpServers: MCP servers passed to Hermes for IDE sessions (stdio: `command` + `args`; http/sse: `url`).
cfg.askEveryCommand: Ask before every terminal command the agent runs, not only the ones Hermes considers risky. Uses a Hermes `pre_tool_call` hook that only acts when Hermes is started by the IDE.
cfg.nodePath: Node.js used to run the terminal approval hook. Empty = Node on `PATH`, then the Node bundled with Hermes.
cfg.useCtrlK: Bind Ctrl+K (when text is selected) to Hermes inline edit. Turn off to keep VS Code's Ctrl+K chords with a selection.
cfg.completionEnabled: Inline Tab suggestions from a separate FIM model (outside Hermes).
cfg.completionBaseUrl: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the FIM model, e.g. `http://localhost:11434/v1` (Ollama) or a vLLM server. The API key is kept in SecretStorage.
cfg.completionTemplate: How the fill-in-the-middle prompt is built. `auto` picks from the model name; `suffix` lets the server do it from `prompt` + `suffix`.
cfg.completionMaxTokens: Maximum tokens per multi-line suggestion (single-line suggestions use at most 48).
cfg.completionDebounce: Wait this long after typing before asking the model.
cfg.indexEnabled: Embed workspace files for semantic search (@codebase and the codebase_search tool for Hermes).
cfg.indexBaseUrl: OpenAI-compatible base URL for `/embeddings`. The API key is kept in SecretStorage.
cfg.indexMaxFileKB: Skip files larger than this when indexing.
